items.question: Trong câu "An architecture review asks harder questions: how big is the image and what is inside it, does it run as root, where are the secrets, what happens when it hangs or dies, can it starve the host, where do the logs go, and can we trust what we deploy?", từ "starve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An architecture review asks harder questions: how big is the image and what is inside it, does it run as root, where are the secrets, what happens when it hangs or dies, can it starve the host, where do the logs go, and can we trust what we deploy?", what does "starve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: starve /stɑːrv/ (động từ): làm thiếu (tài nguyên). "Starve the host" = chiếm hết CPU/RAM khiến máy chủ và các tiến trình khác thiếu tài nguyên; nghĩa gốc là "bỏ đói".
items.explanationEn: starve /stɑːrv/ (verb): to deprive of needed resources. "Starve the host" means taking so much CPU or memory that other processes go without; the literal sense is "to leave without food".

items.question: Trong câu "The guiding idea: a production image is an immutable, minimal, least-privilege artifact, built once and promoted unchanged through every environment.", từ "immutable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The guiding idea: a production image is an immutable, minimal, least-privilege artifact, built once and promoted unchanged through every environment.", what does "immutable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: immutable /ɪˈmjuː.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): bất biến, không thay đổi. Ảnh container bất biến: muốn thay đổi thì build ảnh mới chứ không sửa ảnh cũ. Trái nghĩa: mutable.
items.explanationEn: immutable /ɪˈmjuː.tə.bəl/ (adjective): unable to be changed. An immutable image is never edited in place; you build a new one instead. Opposite: mutable.

items.question: Trong câu "The guiding idea: a production image is an immutable, minimal, least-privilege artifact, built once and promoted unchanged through every environment.", từ "promote" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The guiding idea: a production image is an immutable, minimal, least-privilege artifact, built once and promoted unchanged through every environment.", what does "promote" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to raise to a higher job
to move on to the next stage
items.explanation: promote /prəˈmoʊt/ (động từ): chuyển lên (môi trường tiếp theo). "Promote an image" = đưa cùng một ảnh từ dev lên staging rồi prod; nghĩa thường gặp khác là "thăng chức".
items.explanationEn: promote /prəˈmoʊt/ (verb): to move on to the next stage. "Promote an image" means moving the same build from dev to staging to prod; the everyday sense is "to give someone a higher job".

items.question: Trong câu "Only configuration differs.", từ "differ" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Only configuration differs.", what does "differ" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: differ /ˈdɪf.ər/ (động từ): khác nhau. "Differ" = khác nhau; cụm hay gặp: "differ from" (khác với), "differ in" (khác ở điểm).
items.explanationEn: differ /ˈdɪf.ər/ (verb): to be different. "Differ" means to be different; common patterns: "differ from" and "differ in".

items.question: Trong câu "A build needs compilers, dev dependencies and test tools; the running app needs none of them.", từ "dependency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A build needs compilers, dev dependencies and test tools; the running app needs none of them.", what does "dependency" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a package the code relies on
items.explanation: dependency /dɪˈpen.dən.si/ (danh từ): thư viện phụ thuộc. "Dev dependencies" = các thư viện chỉ cần khi phát triển/build; nghĩa chung là "sự lệ thuộc".
items.explanationEn: dependency /dɪˈpen.dən.si/ (noun): a package the code relies on. "Dev dependencies" are packages needed only while building; the general sense is "reliance on someone".

items.question: Trong câu "A multi-stage build has several FROM lines; only the last stage becomes the image, and it copies just the artifacts it needs with COPY --from=.", từ "artifact" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A multi-stage build has several FROM lines; only the last stage becomes the image, and it copies just the artifacts it needs with COPY --from=.", what does "artifact" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a file produced by a build
items.explanation: artifact /ˈɑːr.tɪ.fækt/ (danh từ): sản phẩm đầu ra (của build). Trong phần mềm, "artifact" là tệp sinh ra từ build (binary, thư mục dist...); nghĩa thường là "cổ vật".
items.explanationEn: artifact /ˈɑːr.tɪ.fækt/ (noun): a file produced by a build. In software, an artifact is an output of a build such as a binary or a dist folder; the everyday sense is "an old historical object".

items.question: Trong câu "docker build --target build . stops at a named stage (useful for running tests in CI).", từ "stage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "docker build --target build . stops at a named stage (useful for running tests in CI).", what does "stage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: stage /steɪdʒ/ (danh từ): giai đoạn, bước. "Build stage" = một giai đoạn trong Dockerfile nhiều giai đoạn; nghĩa khác của "stage" là "sân khấu".
items.explanationEn: stage /steɪdʒ/ (noun): a step in a process. A build stage is one phase of a multi-stage Dockerfile; another sense of "stage" is "a platform for shows".

items.question: Trong câu "The toolchain, source and dev dependencies stay in the discarded stage: a smaller image, fewer CVEs, fewer tools for an attacker.", từ "discard" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The toolchain, source and dev dependencies stay in the discarded stage: a smaller image, fewer CVEs, fewer tools for an attacker.", what does "discard" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: discard /dɪˈskɑːrd/ (động từ): loại bỏ, vứt đi. "Discarded stage" = giai đoạn bị bỏ đi, không có trong ảnh cuối. Cụm: "discard changes" (hủy thay đổi).
items.explanationEn: discard /dɪˈskɑːrd/ (verb): to throw away. A discarded stage is thrown away and not part of the final image. Collocation: "discard changes".

items.question: Trong câu "The toolchain, source and dev dependencies stay in the discarded stage: a smaller image, fewer CVEs, fewer tools for an attacker.", từ "attacker" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The toolchain, source and dev dependencies stay in the discarded stage: a smaller image, fewer CVEs, fewer tools for an attacker.", what does "attacker" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person who uses the app
items.explanation: attacker /əˈtæk.ər/ (danh từ): kẻ tấn công. Ít công cụ trong ảnh thì kẻ tấn công có ít thứ để lợi dụng. Cụm: "attack surface" (bề mặt tấn công).
items.explanationEn: attacker /əˈtæk.ər/ (noun): a person who attacks. Fewer tools in the image leave an attacker less to abuse. Related: "attack surface".

items.question: Trong câu "BuildKit, the default builder since Docker Engine 23.0, skips stages the target does not need and builds independent stages in parallel.", từ "independent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BuildKit, the default builder since Docker Engine 23.0, skips stages the target does not need and builds independent stages in parallel.", what does "independent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: independent /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt/ (tính từ): độc lập, không phụ thuộc. "Independent stages" = các giai đoạn không cần kết quả của nhau nên chạy song song được. Cụm: "independent of".
items.explanationEn: independent /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt/ (adjective): not relying on another. Independent stages do not need each other's output, so they can run at once. Pattern: "independent of".

items.question: Trong câu "BuildKit, the default builder since Docker Engine 23.0, skips stages the target does not need and builds independent stages in parallel.", từ "in parallel" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BuildKit, the default builder since Docker Engine 23.0, skips stages the target does not need and builds independent stages in parallel.", what does "in parallel" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in parallel /ɪn ˈpær.ə.lel/ (cụm từ): song song, cùng lúc. "In parallel" = đồng thời; trái nghĩa: "in sequence / sequentially" (tuần tự).
items.explanationEn: in parallel /ɪn ˈpær.ə.lel/ (phrase): at the same time. "In parallel" means simultaneously; opposite: "in sequence".

items.question: Trong câu "A static Go binary shows the extreme end:", từ "extreme" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A static Go binary shows the extreme end:", what does "extreme" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: extreme /ɪkˈstriːm/ (tính từ): cực đoan, tận cùng. "The extreme end" = đầu mút xa nhất của một dải lựa chọn (ở đây: ảnh nhỏ nhất có thể).
items.explanationEn: extreme /ɪkˈstriːm/ (adjective): furthest from the centre. "The extreme end" is the far end of a range of options (here, the smallest possible image).

items.question: Trong câu "The result is roughly the binary, CA certificates and a nonroot user (UID 65532).", từ "roughly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The result is roughly the binary, CA certificates and a nonroot user (UID 65532).", what does "roughly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: roughly /ˈrʌf.li/ (trạng từ): xấp xỉ, đại khái. "Roughly" = khoảng, gần như; nghĩa khác là "thô bạo, mạnh tay" (treat roughly).
items.explanationEn: roughly /ˈrʌf.li/ (adverb): approximately. "Roughly" means approximately; another sense is "in a violent way", as in "treat roughly".

items.question: Trong câu "Rule of thumb: slim for interpreted runtimes, distroless or scratch for static binaries, Alpine only once you have tested musl.", từ "rule of thumb" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rule of thumb: slim for interpreted runtimes, distroless or scratch for static binaries, Alpine only once you have tested musl.", what does "rule of thumb" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (cụm từ): quy tắc kinh nghiệm. "Rule of thumb" = nguyên tắc dựa trên kinh nghiệm, đúng trong đa số trường hợp, không phải luật cứng.
items.explanationEn: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (phrase): a practical guideline. A rule of thumb is a guideline from experience that works most of the time, not a strict rule.

items.question: Trong câu "Rule of thumb: slim for interpreted runtimes, distroless or scratch for static binaries, Alpine only once you have tested musl.", từ "interpreted" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rule of thumb: slim for interpreted runtimes, distroless or scratch for static binaries, Alpine only once you have tested musl.", what does "interpreted" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: interpreted /ɪnˈtɜːr.prə.tɪd/ (tính từ): được thông dịch (khi chạy). "Interpreted runtimes" (Node, Python) chạy mã qua trình thông dịch; từ gốc "interpret" còn nghĩa "phiên dịch".
items.explanationEn: interpreted /ɪnˈtɜːr.prə.tɪd/ (adjective): executed by an interpreter. Interpreted runtimes such as Node or Python run code through an interpreter; "interpret" also means "to translate speech".

items.question: Trong câu "Without a .dockerignore that includes .git, node_modules and .env: slow builds, a cache busted by any file change under COPY . ., and secrets copied into the image.", từ "bust" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without a .dockerignore that includes .git, node_modules and .env: slow builds, a cache busted by any file change under COPY . ., and secrets copied into the image.", what does "bust" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bust /bʌst/ (động từ): làm mất hiệu lực (cache). "Cache busting" = làm cache không dùng lại được; nghĩa đời thường của "bust" là "làm vỡ".
items.explanationEn: bust /bʌst/ (verb): to invalidate a cache. "Cache busting" makes a cache unusable; the everyday sense of "bust" is "to break".

items.question: Trong câu "Reproducibility rules reviewers check:", từ "reproducibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reproducibility rules reviewers check:", what does "reproducibility" (noun) mean?
options: khả năng tái tạo y hệt
items.explanation: reproducibility /ˌriː.prəˌduː.səˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): khả năng tái tạo y hệt. "Reproducible build" = build lại bất cứ lúc nào cũng ra cùng kết quả; gốc từ "reproduce" (tái tạo).
items.explanationEn: reproducibility /ˌriː.prəˌduː.səˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): ability to recreate identically. A reproducible build gives the same result every time it is rebuilt; from "reproduce".

items.question: Trong câu "Never deploy :latest — it is a mutable pointer.", từ "mutable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Never deploy :latest — it is a mutable pointer.", what does "mutable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mutable /ˈmjuː.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể thay đổi. Tag ":latest" có thể trỏ sang ảnh khác bất cứ lúc nào nên nó "mutable". Trái nghĩa: immutable.
items.explanationEn: mutable /ˈmjuː.tə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be changed. The ":latest" tag can be moved to another image at any time, so it is mutable. Opposite: immutable.

items.question: Trong câu "Pin base images by digest (FROM node:22-bookworm-slim@sha256:…) and let Renovate/Dependabot bump it.", từ "pin" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pin base images by digest (FROM node:22-bookworm-slim@sha256:…) and let Renovate/Dependabot bump it.", what does "pin" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to fix to an exact version
items.explanation: pin /pɪn/ (động từ): cố định (phiên bản). "Pin a version" = khóa chính xác một phiên bản để build không tự thay đổi; nghĩa gốc là "ghim".
items.explanationEn: pin /pɪn/ (verb): to fix to an exact version. "Pin a version" means locking to one exact version so builds do not drift; the literal sense is "to attach with a pin".

items.question: Trong câu "Pin base images by digest (FROM node:22-bookworm-slim@sha256:…) and let Renovate/Dependabot bump it.", từ "digest" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pin base images by digest (FROM node:22-bookworm-slim@sha256:…) and let Renovate/Dependabot bump it.", what does "digest" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: digest /ˈdaɪ.dʒest/ (danh từ): mã băm (định danh nội dung). Digest (vd sha256:...) là mã băm của nội dung ảnh, không thể dời như tag; nghĩa khác: "bản tin tóm tắt".
items.explanationEn: digest /ˈdaɪ.dʒest/ (noun): a content hash identifier. A digest such as sha256:... is a hash of the image content and cannot be moved like a tag; another sense is "a news summary".

items.question: Trong câu "Pin base images by digest (FROM node:22-bookworm-slim@sha256:…) and let Renovate/Dependabot bump it.", từ "bump" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pin base images by digest (FROM node:22-bookworm-slim@sha256:…) and let Renovate/Dependabot bump it.", what does "bump" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to raise to a newer version
items.explanation: bump /bʌmp/ (động từ): nâng (lên phiên bản mới). "Bump a version" = tăng số phiên bản; nghĩa đời thường là "va, đụng".
items.explanationEn: bump /bʌmp/ (verb): to raise to a newer version. "Bump a version" means increasing the version number; the everyday sense is "to knock against something".

items.question: Trong câu "Use lockfiles with strict installs (npm ci, go mod download).", từ "strict" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use lockfiles with strict installs (npm ci, go mod download).", what does "strict" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: strict /strɪkt/ (tính từ): nghiêm ngặt, chặt chẽ. "Strict install" chỉ cài đúng phiên bản trong lockfile. Cụm: "strict mode", "strictly required".
items.explanationEn: strict /strɪkt/ (adjective): following rules exactly. A strict install uses exactly the versions in the lockfile. Collocations: "strict mode", "strictly required".

items.question: Trong câu "By default the container process runs as root (UID 0) — the same UID 0 as the host unless user namespaces are enabled.", từ "by default" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "By default the container process runs as root (UID 0) — the same UID 0 as the host unless user namespaces are enabled.", what does "by default" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by default /baɪ dɪˈfɔːlt/ (cụm từ): theo mặc định. "By default" = khi không cấu hình gì khác. Cụm: "default value", "default setting".
items.explanationEn: by default /baɪ dɪˈfɔːlt/ (phrase): unless set otherwise. "By default" describes what happens when nothing else is configured. Related: "default value".

items.question: Trong câu "A kernel escape, a writable host mount or a mounted Docker socket then means host root.", từ "escape" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A kernel escape, a writable host mount or a mounted Docker socket then means host root.", what does "escape" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: escape /ɪˈskeɪp/ (danh từ): sự thoát ra (khỏi cô lập). "Container escape" = tiến trình phá vỡ cô lập để chạm tới máy chủ; "escape" còn nghĩa "bỏ trốn".
items.explanationEn: escape /ɪˈskeɪp/ (noun): a break out of isolation. A container escape is a process breaking out of isolation to reach the host; "escape" also means "a flight from prison".

items.question: Trong câu "Then harden the runtime:", từ "harden" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Then harden the runtime:", what does "harden" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: harden /ˈhɑːr.dən/ (động từ): gia cố bảo mật. "Harden a system" = giảm bề mặt tấn công bằng cấu hình chặt; nghĩa gốc là "làm cứng".
items.explanationEn: harden /ˈhɑːr.dən/ (verb): to make more secure. "Harden a system" means tightening its configuration to reduce risk; the literal sense is "to make firm".

items.question: Trong câu "both are effectively root on the host.", từ "effectively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "both are effectively root on the host.", what does "effectively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: effectively /ɪˈfek.tɪv.li/ (trạng từ): về thực chất, coi như. Ở đây "effectively" = "trên thực tế là, coi như là"; nghĩa khác phổ biến là "một cách hiệu quả".
items.explanationEn: effectively /ɪˈfek.tɪv.li/ (adverb): in practice, essentially. Here "effectively" means "in practice"; the other common sense is "in a successful way".

items.question: Trong câu "Rootless Docker or userns-remap go further by mapping container root to an unprivileged host UID.", từ "unprivileged" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rootless Docker or userns-remap go further by mapping container root to an unprivileged host UID.", what does "unprivileged" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unprivileged /ʌnˈprɪv.əl.ɪdʒd/ (tính từ): không có quyền đặc biệt. "Unprivileged user" = người dùng thường, không có quyền quản trị. Trái nghĩa: privileged.
items.explanationEn: unprivileged /ʌnˈprɪv.əl.ɪdʒd/ (adjective): lacking special permissions. An unprivileged user is an ordinary account without admin rights. Opposite: privileged.

items.question: Trong câu "Layers are additive and metadata is readable by anyone who can pull the image:", từ "additive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Layers are additive and metadata is readable by anyone who can pull the image:", what does "additive" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: adding on top of earlier parts
items.explanation: additive /ˈæd.ə.tɪv/ (tính từ): cộng dồn, chồng thêm. Layer "additive": mỗi lớp chỉ thêm lên trên, xóa tệp ở lớp sau không xóa dữ liệu ở lớp trước. Danh từ "additive" còn là "chất phụ gia".
items.explanationEn: additive /ˈæd.ə.tɪv/ (adjective): adding on top of earlier parts. Additive layers only add on top, so deleting a file later does not remove earlier bytes. As a noun, "additive" also means "a food additive".

items.question: Trong câu "For private Git dependencies, RUN --mount=type=ssh with docker build --ssh default forwards the SSH agent instead of copying a key.", từ "forward" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For private Git dependencies, RUN --mount=type=ssh with docker build --ssh default forwards the SSH agent instead of copying a key.", what does "forward" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to pass on to another place
items.explanation: forward /ˈfɔːr.wərd/ (động từ): chuyển tiếp. "Forward the SSH agent" = chuyển tiếp kết nối tới agent thay vì sao chép khóa. Cụm: "forward a port", "forward an email".
items.explanationEn: forward /ˈfɔːr.wərd/ (verb): to pass on to another place. "Forward the SSH agent" passes access through instead of copying a key. Collocations: "forward a port", "forward an email".

items.question: Trong câu "Runtime — inject, never bake:", từ "bake" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Runtime — inject, never bake:", what does "bake" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bake /beɪk/ (động từ): đóng cứng (vào ảnh). "Bake into the image" = ghi cố định vào ảnh lúc build; nghĩa gốc là "nướng bánh".
items.explanationEn: bake /beɪk/ (verb): to build permanently into. "Bake into the image" means fixing something into it at build time; the literal sense is "to cook in an oven".

items.question: Trong câu "On AWS, an ECS task definition references Secrets Manager or SSM ARNs and injects them at start.", từ "inject" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On AWS, an ECS task definition references Secrets Manager or SSM ARNs and injects them at start.", what does "inject" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to give a drug by needle
items.explanation: inject /ɪnˈdʒekt/ (động từ): đưa vào (lúc chạy). "Inject secrets" = cấp bí mật cho container khi khởi động; nghĩa y khoa là "tiêm". Cụm: "dependency injection".
items.explanationEn: inject /ɪnˈdʒekt/ (verb): to supply at runtime. "Inject secrets" means supplying them when the container starts; the medical sense is "to give by needle". Related: "dependency injection".

items.question: Trong câu "A running process is not a working service — it may be deadlocked or still warming up.", từ "deadlock" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A running process is not a working service — it may be deadlocked or still warming up.", what does "deadlock" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to be locked out of an account
to be stuck waiting on each other
items.explanation: deadlock /ˈded.lɒk/ (động từ): bị kẹt chờ lẫn nhau. "Deadlock" = các luồng chờ khóa của nhau mãi mãi, tiến trình còn sống nhưng không làm gì được.
items.explanationEn: deadlock /ˈded.lɒk/ (verb): to be stuck waiting on each other. In a deadlock, threads wait on each other's locks forever, so the process is alive but does no work.

items.question: Trong câu "A running process is not a working service — it may be deadlocked or still warming up.", từ "warm up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A running process is not a working service — it may be deadlocked or still warming up.", what does "warm up" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: warm up /wɔːrm ʌp/ (cụm từ): khởi động, làm nóng máy. "Warm up" ở đây = giai đoạn nạp cache, kết nối trước khi phục vụ được; nghĩa khác là "khởi động trước khi tập".
items.explanationEn: warm up /wɔːrm ʌp/ (phrase): to get ready after starting. "Warm up" here is the phase of loading caches and connections before serving; it also means "to exercise before sport".

items.question: Trong câu "Plain Docker only reports health — it does not restart an unhealthy container.", từ "plain" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Plain Docker only reports health — it does not restart an unhealthy container.", what does "plain" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: plain /pleɪn/ (tính từ): đơn thuần, không thêm gì. "Plain Docker" = Docker trơn, không kèm Compose/Swarm/Kubernetes. Cụm: "plain text" (văn bản thuần).
items.explanationEn: plain /pleɪn/ (adjective): basic, with nothing added. "Plain Docker" means Docker alone, without Compose, Swarm or Kubernetes. Related: "plain text".

items.question: Trong câu "and Kubernetes ignores HEALTHCHECK in favour of its own probes (topic 7).", từ "in favour of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "and Kubernetes ignores HEALTHCHECK in favour of its own probes (topic 7).", what does "in favour of" (phrase) mean?
options: để dùng thứ khác thay thế
items.explanation: in favour of /ɪn ˈfeɪ.vər əv/ (cụm từ): để dùng thứ khác thay thế. "Ignore X in favour of Y" = bỏ X để dùng Y; nghĩa khác: "be in favour of" = ủng hộ.
items.explanationEn: in favour of /ɪn ˈfeɪ.vər əv/ (phrase): choosing something else instead. "Ignore X in favour of Y" means using Y instead of X; "be in favour of" also means "to support".

items.question: Trong câu "and Kubernetes ignores HEALTHCHECK in favour of its own probes (topic 7).", từ "probe" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "and Kubernetes ignores HEALTHCHECK in favour of its own probes (topic 7).", what does "probe" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: probe /proʊb/ (danh từ): phép kiểm tra định kỳ. Kubernetes dùng liveness/readiness probe để kiểm tra container; "probe" còn nghĩa "tàu thăm dò" hay "cuộc điều tra".
items.explanationEn: probe /proʊb/ (noun): a repeated automated check. Kubernetes uses liveness and readiness probes to check containers; "probe" also means "a space probe" or "an investigation".

items.question: Trong câu "Keep the endpoint cheap: checking every dependency turns one DB blip into a fleet-wide "unhealthy".", từ "blip" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep the endpoint cheap: checking every dependency turns one DB blip into a fleet-wide "unhealthy".", what does "blip" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: blip /blɪp/ (danh từ): sự trục trặc thoáng qua. "A DB blip" = cơ sở dữ liệu trục trặc vài giây; nghĩa gốc là "đốm sáng / tiếng bíp trên radar".
items.explanationEn: blip /blɪp/ (noun): a brief temporary problem. "A DB blip" is a database hiccup lasting seconds; the original sense is "a dot or beep on a radar".

items.question: Trong câu "Graceful shutdown: docker stop sends SIGTERM, waits 10 seconds (-t to change), then SIGKILL.", từ "graceful" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Graceful shutdown: docker stop sends SIGTERM, waits 10 seconds (-t to change), then SIGKILL.", what does "graceful" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: graceful /ˈɡreɪs.fəl/ (tính từ): êm, có trật tự. "Graceful shutdown" = dừng có trật tự: xử lý xong request rồi mới thoát; nghĩa đời thường là "duyên dáng".
items.explanationEn: graceful /ˈɡreɪs.fəl/ (adjective): orderly, without losing work. A graceful shutdown finishes in-flight work before exiting; the everyday sense is "elegant".

items.question: Trong câu "Two traps make apps miss SIGTERM:", từ "trap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two traps make apps miss SIGTERM:", what does "trap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trap /træp/ (danh từ): cái bẫy, lỗi dễ mắc. Ở đây "trap" = lỗi dễ mắc phải (gần nghĩa "pitfall"); nghĩa gốc là "bẫy thú".
items.explanationEn: trap /træp/ (noun): a hidden common mistake. Here "trap" means an easy mistake, close to "pitfall"; the literal sense is "a device to catch animals".

items.question: Trong câu "Handle it in code or run with docker run --init (tini forwards signals and reaps zombies).", từ "reap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Handle it in code or run with docker run --init (tini forwards signals and reaps zombies).", what does "reap" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reap /riːp/ (động từ): dọn dẹp (tiến trình đã chết). "Reap zombies" = thu dọn tiến trình con đã kết thúc; nghĩa gốc là "gặt hái". Thành ngữ: "reap the benefits".
items.explanationEn: reap /riːp/ (verb): to clean up dead processes. "Reap zombies" means collecting finished child processes; the literal sense is "to harvest". Idiom: "reap the benefits".

items.question: Trong câu "Docker adds a growing delay between restarts (doubling from 100 ms), so a crash loop shows Restarting in docker ps.", từ "delay" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Docker adds a growing delay between restarts (doubling from 100 ms), so a crash loop shows Restarting in docker ps.", what does "delay" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: delay /dɪˈleɪ/ (danh từ): khoảng trễ, thời gian chờ. "A growing delay" = khoảng chờ tăng dần giữa các lần khởi động lại (exponential backoff).
items.explanationEn: delay /dɪˈleɪ/ (noun): a period of waiting. "A growing delay" is a wait that increases between restarts, known as exponential backoff.

items.question: Trong câu "Without resource limits, one container can consume all host memory and CPU:", từ "consume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without resource limits, one container can consume all host memory and CPU:", what does "consume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consume /kənˈsuːm/ (động từ): tiêu thụ, dùng hết. "Consume memory/CPU" = sử dụng tài nguyên; cụm: "resource consumption". Nghĩa khác: "ăn uống".
items.explanationEn: consume /kənˈsuːm/ (verb): to use up. "Consume memory or CPU" means using those resources; related: "resource consumption". It can also mean "to eat or drink".

items.question: Trong câu "--memory is a hard cgroup cap.", từ "cap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "--memory is a hard cgroup cap.", what does "cap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: cap /kæp/ (danh từ): mức trần, giới hạn trên. "A hard cap" = giới hạn trên tuyệt đối không được vượt; "cap" còn nghĩa "mũ lưỡi trai" hay "nắp".
items.explanationEn: cap /kæp/ (noun): an upper limit. "A hard cap" is an absolute upper limit; "cap" also means "a hat" or "a lid".

items.question: Trong câu "Exceed it and the process is OOM-killed", từ "exceed" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Exceed it and the process is OOM-killed", what does "exceed" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exceed /ɪkˈsiːd/ (động từ): vượt quá. "Exceed a limit" = vượt quá giới hạn. Danh từ: "excess" (phần vượt).
items.explanationEn: exceed /ɪkˈsiːd/ (verb): to go beyond. "Exceed a limit" means going beyond it. Noun: "excess".

items.question: Trong câu "the container is throttled, not killed.", từ "throttle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the container is throttled, not killed.", what does "throttle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: throttle /ˈθrɒt.əl/ (động từ): bóp, hạn chế tốc độ. CPU bị "throttle" = bị hãm tốc độ chứ không bị dừng. Cụm: "API throttling". Nghĩa gốc: "bóp cổ".
items.explanationEn: throttle /ˈθrɒt.əl/ (verb): to limit the speed. A throttled CPU is slowed, not stopped. Related: "API throttling". The literal sense is "to choke".

items.question: Trong câu "is only a relative weight under contention.", từ "contention" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "is only a relative weight under contention.", what does "contention" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: contention /kənˈten.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự tranh chấp (tài nguyên). "Under contention" = khi nhiều container cùng tranh CPU; nghĩa khác: "luận điểm" (my contention is...).
items.explanationEn: contention /kənˈten.ʃən/ (noun): competition for a resource. "Under contention" means when several containers compete for CPU; another sense is "a claim", as in "my contention is".

items.question: Trong câu "The daemon passes both streams to a logging driver.", từ "stream" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The daemon passes both streams to a logging driver.", what does "stream" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: stream /striːm/ (danh từ): luồng dữ liệu. "Both streams" = hai luồng stdout và stderr; nghĩa gốc là "dòng suối". Cụm: "event stream".
items.explanationEn: stream /striːm/ (noun): a flow of data. "Both streams" are stdout and stderr; the literal sense is "a small river". Related: "event stream".

items.question: Trong câu "The classic outage: a chatty container fills the host disk because json-file never rotated.", từ "outage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The classic outage: a chatty container fills the host disk because json-file never rotated.", what does "outage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: outage /ˈaʊ.tɪdʒ/ (danh từ): sự cố ngừng dịch vụ. "Outage" = khoảng thời gian hệ thống ngừng hoạt động. Cụm: "power outage", "cause an outage".
items.explanationEn: outage /ˈaʊ.tɪdʒ/ (noun): a period of service failure. An outage is a time when a system is down. Collocations: "power outage", "cause an outage".

items.question: Trong câu "The classic outage: a chatty container fills the host disk because json-file never rotated.", từ "chatty" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The classic outage: a chatty container fills the host disk because json-file never rotated.", what does "chatty" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: chatty /ˈtʃæt.i/ (tính từ): ghi log quá nhiều. Container "chatty" = in ra rất nhiều log; nghĩa gốc là "nói nhiều". Cụm: "chatty API" (gọi mạng quá nhiều).
items.explanationEn: chatty /ˈtʃæt.i/ (adjective): producing too much output. A chatty container writes lots of logs; the literal sense is "talkative". Related: "chatty API".

items.question: Trong câu "The classic outage: a chatty container fills the host disk because json-file never rotated.", từ "rotate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The classic outage: a chatty container fills the host disk because json-file never rotated.", what does "rotate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to replace old files in cycle
items.explanation: rotate /roʊˈteɪt/ (động từ): xoay vòng (tệp log). "Log rotation" = đóng tệp log cũ, mở tệp mới và xóa bớt tệp cũ; nghĩa gốc là "quay". Cụm: "rotate keys".
items.explanationEn: rotate /roʊˈteɪt/ (verb): to replace old files in cycle. "Log rotation" closes old log files, starts new ones and deletes the oldest; the literal sense is "to turn". Related: "rotate keys".

items.question: Trong câu "Fix it daemon-wide in /etc/docker/daemon.json (applies to containers created afterwards):", từ "afterwards" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fix it daemon-wide in /etc/docker/daemon.json (applies to containers created afterwards):", what does "afterwards" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: afterwards /ˈæf.tər.wərdz/ (trạng từ): sau đó, về sau. "Created afterwards" = được tạo sau khi đổi cấu hình; container cũ không bị ảnh hưởng.
items.explanationEn: afterwards /ˈæf.tər.wərdz/ (adverb): at a later time. "Created afterwards" means created after the change; existing containers are not affected.

items.question: Trong câu "By default logging is blocking: a slow remote driver stalls the app's writes;", từ "stall" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "By default logging is blocking: a slow remote driver stalls the app's writes;", what does "stall" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: stall /stɔːl/ (động từ): làm đình trệ. "Stall the writes" = làm việc ghi bị treo lại; danh từ "stall" còn nghĩa "quầy hàng". Cụm: "the engine stalled".
items.explanationEn: stall /stɔːl/ (verb): to make stop progressing. "Stall the writes" means making them stop moving; the noun "stall" also means "a market booth". Related: "the engine stalled".

items.question: Trong câu "Scan in CI to gate the build and rescan images already in the registry: a clean image today has new CVEs tomorrow.", từ "gate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scan in CI to gate the build and rescan images already in the registry: a clean image today has new CVEs tomorrow.", what does "gate" (verb) mean?
options: chặn nếu không đạt điều kiện
items.explanation: gate /ɡeɪt/ (động từ): chặn nếu không đạt điều kiện. "Gate the build" = bản build chỉ đi tiếp khi vượt qua bước quét; danh từ "gate" là "cổng". Cụm: "quality gate".
items.explanationEn: gate /ɡeɪt/ (verb): to block unless checks pass. "Gate the build" means it only proceeds if the scan passes; the noun "gate" is "an entrance". Related: "quality gate".

items.question: Trong câu "The cure is usually rebuilding on a patched base, which is why small bases and automated rebuilds beat triaging hundreds of findings.", từ "cure" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cure is usually rebuilding on a patched base, which is why small bases and automated rebuilds beat triaging hundreds of findings.", what does "cure" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a way to fix a problem
items.explanation: cure /kjʊr/ (danh từ): cách khắc phục. "The cure" ở đây = giải pháp khắc phục lỗ hổng; nghĩa gốc là "phương thuốc chữa bệnh".
items.explanationEn: cure /kjʊr/ (noun): a way to fix a problem. "The cure" here is the fix for vulnerabilities; the original sense is "a medical treatment".

items.question: Trong câu "The cure is usually rebuilding on a patched base, which is why small bases and automated rebuilds beat triaging hundreds of findings.", từ "patched" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cure is usually rebuilding on a patched base, which is why small bases and automated rebuilds beat triaging hundreds of findings.", what does "patched" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: patched /pætʃt/ (tính từ): đã được vá lỗi. "Patched base" = ảnh nền đã cập nhật bản vá bảo mật. Cụm: "security patch", "patch a bug".
items.explanationEn: patched /pætʃt/ (adjective): updated with fixes. A patched base image includes the latest security fixes. Collocations: "security patch", "patch a bug".

items.question: Trong câu "The cure is usually rebuilding on a patched base, which is why small bases and automated rebuilds beat triaging hundreds of findings.", từ "triage" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cure is usually rebuilding on a patched base, which is why small bases and automated rebuilds beat triaging hundreds of findings.", what does "triage" (verb) mean?
options: phân loại theo mức ưu tiên
items.explanation: triage /ˈtriː.ɑːʒ/ (động từ): phân loại theo mức ưu tiên. "Triage findings" = xem xét và xếp ưu tiên từng lỗi; gốc từ y khoa (phân loại bệnh nhân cấp cứu).
items.explanationEn: triage /ˈtriː.ɑːʒ/ (verb): to sort by urgency. "Triage findings" means reviewing and prioritising each issue; the term comes from emergency medicine.

items.question: Trong câu "The cure is usually rebuilding on a patched base, which is why small bases and automated rebuilds beat triaging hundreds of findings.", từ "finding" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cure is usually rebuilding on a patched base, which is why small bases and automated rebuilds beat triaging hundreds of findings.", what does "finding" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an issue found by a check
items.explanation: finding /ˈfaɪn.dɪŋ/ (danh từ): kết quả phát hiện (lỗi). "Findings" = các vấn đề mà công cụ quét/kiểm toán phát hiện. Cụm: "audit findings", "key findings".
items.explanationEn: finding /ˈfaɪn.dɪŋ/ (noun): an issue found by a check. "Findings" are the issues a scan or audit reports. Collocations: "audit findings", "key findings".

items.question: Trong câu "When a Log4Shell-style CVE lands, you query SBOMs instead of pulling every image.", từ "land" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a Log4Shell-style CVE lands, you query SBOMs instead of pulling every image.", what does "land" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to come down to the ground
items.explanation: land /lænd/ (động từ): xuất hiện, ập đến. "A CVE lands" = một lỗ hổng mới được công bố; nghĩa gốc là "hạ cánh".
items.explanationEn: land /lænd/ (verb): to appear or arrive. "A CVE lands" means a new vulnerability is announced; the literal sense is "to come down to the ground".

items.question: Trong câu "Signing proves the image came from your pipeline unmodified.", từ "unmodified" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Signing proves the image came from your pipeline unmodified.", what does "unmodified" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unmodified /ʌnˈmɒd.ɪ.faɪd/ (tính từ): nguyên vẹn, không bị sửa. "Unmodified" = không bị chỉnh sửa; chữ ký số chứng minh ảnh còn nguyên vẹn. Gốc: "modify".
items.explanationEn: unmodified /ʌnˈmɒd.ɪ.faɪd/ (adjective): not changed. "Unmodified" means not altered; a signature proves the image is intact. Root: "modify".

items.question: Trong câu "Sigstore cosign is the de facto standard and supports keyless signing bound to the CI's OIDC identity:", từ "de facto" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sigstore cosign is the de facto standard and supports keyless signing bound to the CI's OIDC identity:", what does "de facto" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: de facto /ˌdeɪ ˈfæk.toʊ/ (tính từ): trên thực tế (không chính thức). "De facto standard" = chuẩn mọi người thực tế dùng dù không ai ban hành chính thức. Đối lập: "de jure".
items.explanationEn: de facto /ˌdeɪ ˈfæk.toʊ/ (adjective): existing in practice. A de facto standard is what everyone actually uses, even without official approval. Contrast: "de jure".

items.question: Trong câu "Sign the pushed image by digest and deploy by digest, because tags can be moved; enforce verification at deploy time (e.g. a Kubernetes admission policy).", từ "enforce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sign the pushed image by digest and deploy by digest, because tags can be moved; enforce verification at deploy time (e.g. a Kubernetes admission policy).", what does "enforce" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make sure a rule is obeyed
items.explanation: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːrs/ (động từ): bắt buộc thực thi. "Enforce a policy" = bắt buộc áp dụng chính sách, vi phạm thì chặn. Danh từ: "enforcement".
items.explanationEn: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːrs/ (verb): to make sure a rule is obeyed. "Enforce a policy" means blocking anything that breaks it. Noun: "enforcement".

items.question: Trong câu "Docker Content Trust (Notary v1) is the older approach, largely superseded by cosign and Notation.", từ "supersede" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Docker Content Trust (Notary v1) is the older approach, largely superseded by cosign and Notation.", what does "supersede" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: supersede /ˌsuː.pərˈsiːd/ (động từ): thay thế (cái cũ). "Be superseded by" = bị thay thế bởi thứ mới hơn. Cụm hay gặp trong tài liệu: "this API is superseded by...".
items.explanationEn: supersede /ˌsuː.pərˈsiːd/ (verb): to take the place of. "Be superseded by" means being replaced by something newer, common in docs: "this API is superseded by...".

items.question: Trong câu "Python docker-compose v1 reached end of life in 2023", từ "end of life" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Python docker-compose v1 reached end of life in 2023", what does "end of life" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: the end of a person's life
items.explanation: end of life /ˌend əv ˈlaɪf/ (cụm từ): ngừng hỗ trợ. "Reach end of life (EOL)" = hết hạn hỗ trợ, không còn bản vá; nghĩa đen là "cuối đời".
items.explanationEn: end of life /ˌend əv ˈlaɪf/ (phrase): no longer supported. "Reach end of life (EOL)" means no more support or patches; the literal sense is "the end of a life".

items.question: Trong câu "the top-level version: key is obsolete.", từ "obsolete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the top-level version: key is obsolete.", what does "obsolete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: obsolete /ˌɒb.səˈliːt/ (tính từ): lỗi thời, không còn dùng. "Obsolete" = đã lỗi thời. Gần nghĩa: "deprecated" (không khuyến khích dùng, sắp bỏ).
items.explanationEn: obsolete /ˌɒb.səˈliːt/ (adjective): no longer in use. "Obsolete" means no longer used. Close term: "deprecated" (discouraged and due for removal).

items.question: Trong câu "Only api publishes a port, so Postgres is not exposed.", từ "expose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Only api publishes a port, so Postgres is not exposed.", what does "expose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expose /ɪkˈspoʊz/ (động từ): để lộ ra (bên ngoài). "Not exposed" = không truy cập được từ bên ngoài. Cụm: "expose a port", "exposed to attacks".
items.explanationEn: expose /ɪkˈspoʊz/ (verb): to make reachable from outside. "Not exposed" means unreachable from outside. Collocations: "expose a port", "exposed to attacks".

items.question: Trong câu "Apps should still retry connections.", từ "retry" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Apps should still retry connections.", what does "retry" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: retry /ˌriːˈtraɪ/ (động từ): thử lại. "Retry connections" = kết nối lại khi thất bại. Cụm: "retry with backoff", "retry logic".
items.explanationEn: retry /ˌriːˈtraɪ/ (verb): to attempt again. "Retry connections" means trying again after a failure. Collocations: "retry with backoff", "retry logic".

items.question: Trong câu "is merged automatically (dev bind mounts);", từ "merge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "is merged automatically (dev bind mounts);", what does "merge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: merge /mɜːrdʒ/ (động từ): gộp, hợp nhất. Tệp override được gộp vào tệp chính. Cụm: "merge a branch", "merge conflict"; trong kinh doanh là "sáp nhập".
items.explanationEn: merge /mɜːrdʒ/ (verb): to combine into one. The override file is combined with the main file. Collocations: "merge a branch", "merge conflict"; in business, "to join companies".

items.question: Trong câu "Not enough for: multiple hosts, cross-node self-healing, rolling deploys, autoscaling — that is orchestration (Kubernetes, topic 6; ECS on AWS).", từ "rolling" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not enough for: multiple hosts, cross-node self-healing, rolling deploys, autoscaling — that is orchestration (Kubernetes, topic 6; ECS on AWS).", what does "rolling" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: rolling /ˈroʊ.lɪŋ/ (tính từ): cuốn chiếu, lần lượt. "Rolling deploy" = thay dần từng bản sao, không dừng toàn bộ dịch vụ. Cụm: "rolling update".
items.explanationEn: rolling /ˈroʊ.lɪŋ/ (adjective): replacing parts one by one. A rolling deploy replaces instances one at a time without full downtime. Related: "rolling update".

items.question: Trong câu "Not enough for: multiple hosts, cross-node self-healing, rolling deploys, autoscaling — that is orchestration (Kubernetes, topic 6; ECS on AWS).", từ "orchestration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not enough for: multiple hosts, cross-node self-healing, rolling deploys, autoscaling — that is orchestration (Kubernetes, topic 6; ECS on AWS).", what does "orchestration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: orchestration /ˌɔːr.kəˈstreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): điều phối (hệ thống). "Container orchestration" = tự động lên lịch, mở rộng, tự phục hồi container trên nhiều máy; gốc âm nhạc là "phối khí".
items.explanationEn: orchestration /ˌɔːr.kəˈstreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): automated coordination of services. Container orchestration automates scheduling, scaling and healing across hosts; in music it means "arranging for an orchestra".

items.question: Trong câu "The Twelve-Factor App (Heroku, 2011) is a checklist for apps that fit containers.", từ "checklist" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Twelve-Factor App (Heroku, 2011) is a checklist for apps that fit containers.", what does "checklist" (noun) mean?
options: danh sách mục cần kiểm tra
optionsEn: a list of items to verify
items.explanation: checklist /ˈtʃek.lɪst/ (danh từ): danh sách mục cần kiểm tra. "Checklist" = danh sách các điểm cần đáp ứng/kiểm tra lần lượt. Cụm: "go through a checklist".
items.explanationEn: checklist /ˈtʃek.lɪst/ (noun): a list of items to verify. A checklist is a list of points to verify one by one. Collocation: "go through a checklist".

items.question: Trong câu "The Twelve-Factor App (Heroku, 2011) is a checklist for apps that fit containers.", từ "fit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Twelve-Factor App (Heroku, 2011) is a checklist for apps that fit containers.", what does "fit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: fit /fɪt/ (động từ): phù hợp với. "Apps that fit containers" = ứng dụng hợp với mô hình container; nghĩa khác: "vừa (quần áo)". Cụm: "a good fit".
items.explanationEn: fit /fɪt/ (verb): to be suitable for. "Apps that fit containers" suit the container model; another sense is "to be the right size". Related: "a good fit".

items.question: Trong câu "Most often violated: config baked into images, processes keeping sessions on local disk, disposability ignored by apps that miss SIGTERM, and logs written to files.", từ "violate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most often violated: config baked into images, processes keeping sessions on local disk, disposability ignored by apps that miss SIGTERM, and logs written to files.", what does "violate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: violate /ˈvaɪ.ə.leɪt/ (động từ): vi phạm. "Violate a principle/policy" = làm trái nguyên tắc. Danh từ: "violation".
items.explanationEn: violate /ˈvaɪ.ə.leɪt/ (verb): to break a rule. "Violate a principle or policy" means breaking it. Noun: "violation".

items.question: Trong câu "Most often violated: config baked into images, processes keeping sessions on local disk, disposability ignored by apps that miss SIGTERM, and logs written to files.", từ "disposability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most often violated: config baked into images, processes keeping sessions on local disk, disposability ignored by apps that miss SIGTERM, and logs written to files.", what does "disposability" (noun) mean?
options: tính dễ bỏ đi và thay thế
items.explanation: disposability /dɪˌspoʊ.zəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): tính dễ bỏ đi và thay thế. Trong twelve-factor, "disposability" = tiến trình khởi động nhanh, tắt êm, có thể hủy bất cứ lúc nào; gốc từ "disposable" (dùng một lần).
items.explanationEn: disposability /dɪˌspoʊ.zəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): ease of stopping and replacing. In twelve-factor, disposability means processes start fast and stop cleanly so they can be killed anytime; from "disposable".

items.question: Trong câu "Migrations run as one-off containers from the same image", từ "one-off" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Migrations run as one-off containers from the same image", what does "one-off" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: one-off /ˌwʌn ˈɒf/ (tính từ): chạy một lần rồi thôi. "One-off container" = container chạy một tác vụ rồi thoát (vd migration). Cụm: "a one-off job".
items.explanationEn: one-off /ˌwʌn ˈɒf/ (adjective): happening only once. A one-off container runs a single task and exits, such as a migration. Collocation: "a one-off job".

items.question: Trong câu "Compose is single-host; depends_on needs service_healthy to wait for readiness.", từ "readiness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Compose is single-host; depends_on needs service_healthy to wait for readiness.", what does "readiness" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: readiness /ˈred.i.nəs/ (danh từ): trạng thái sẵn sàng. "Wait for readiness" = đợi dịch vụ sẵn sàng nhận request. Cụm: "readiness probe".
items.explanationEn: readiness /ˈred.i.nəs/ (noun): the state of being prepared. "Wait for readiness" means waiting until a service can accept requests. Related: "readiness probe".

items.question: Trong câu "CPU limits throttle rather than kill.", từ "rather than" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CPU limits throttle rather than kill.", what does "rather than" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rather than /ˈræð.ər ðæn/ (cụm từ): thay vì. "X rather than Y" = làm X chứ không làm Y. Cụm tương đương: "instead of".
items.explanationEn: rather than /ˈræð.ər ðæn/ (phrase): instead of. "X rather than Y" means doing X and not Y. Equivalent: "instead of".

items.question: Trong câu "Non-root users, runtime hardening and BuildKit secret mounts limit damage and keep credentials out of layers.", từ "credential" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Non-root users, runtime hardening and BuildKit secret mounts limit damage and keep credentials out of layers.", what does "credential" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: credential /krəˈden.ʃəl/ (danh từ): thông tin xác thực. "Credentials" = mật khẩu, khóa, token dùng để xác thực; nghĩa khác: "bằng cấp, chứng chỉ" của một người.
items.explanationEn: credential /krəˈden.ʃəl/ (noun): a password, key or token. "Credentials" are passwords, keys or tokens for authentication; another sense is "a person's qualifications".

items.question: Trong câu "Healthchecks, signal-aware shutdown, restart policies and resource limits make failure predictable.", từ "predictable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Healthchecks, signal-aware shutdown, restart policies and resource limits make failure predictable.", what does "predictable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: predictable /prɪˈdɪk.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể đoán trước. "Make failure predictable" = khi hỏng thì hỏng theo cách đã biết trước và xử lý được. Danh từ: "predictability".
items.explanationEn: predictable /prɪˈdɪk.tə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be foreseen. "Make failure predictable" means failures happen in known, manageable ways. Noun: "predictability".

items.question: Trong câu "Logs go to stdout through a rotating or shipping driver; scanning, SBOMs and signing secure the supply chain.", từ "supply chain" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Logs go to stdout through a rotating or shipping driver; scanning, SBOMs and signing secure the supply chain.", what does "supply chain" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: the path software takes to deploy
items.explanation: supply chain /səˈplaɪ tʃeɪn/ (cụm từ): chuỗi cung ứng (phần mềm). "Software supply chain" = mọi thứ từ mã nguồn, thư viện, build tới triển khai. Cụm: "supply chain attack".
items.explanationEn: supply chain /səˈplaɪ tʃeɪn/ (phrase): the path software takes to deploy. The software supply chain covers source, dependencies, builds and deployment. Related: "supply chain attack".
